title: Beta Development Notes - 2 November
headline: Every class hits harder: damage is up across the game and higher level creatures get more health to match

fixes.name: Class damage raised
fixes.text: Damage is raised for every class, and higher level creatures get more health to compensate. No big tuning changes are planned before the raids open next month.

fixes.name: Low-rank spells
fixes.text: Talents no longer have a lower chance to trigger from low-rank spells. Blizzard still does, for ranks learned more than 12 levels ago.

fixes.name: Training costs
fixes.text: Training every class ability from 1 to 60 now costs 206 to 207 gold for every class. For Warlocks, the expected cost of pet Grimoires is taken off.

fixes.name: New spells and action bars
fixes.text: Learning a new spell no longer places it on your action bars.

fixes.name: Racial base stats
fixes.text: Every race now has the correct base stats. A Tauren Warrior starts with +5 Strength over a Human Warrior (was +2).

fixes.name: Proc roots
fixes.text: Roots from procs now have Diminishing Returns. Applies to Frostbite, Entrapment, Improved Wing Clip, Counterattack and Improved Hamstring.

fixes.name: Throw
fixes.text: Uses the 0.5 second windup instead of the throwing weapon's attack speed.

fixes.name: Quitter debuff and stun
fixes.text: The quitter debuff lasts 40 seconds (was 5 minutes). The stun lasts 2.5 seconds (was 3).

abilities.name: Artisan's Precision
abilities.text: +1% hit chance with spells and attacks.

abilities.name: Read Leyline
abilities.text: +50% Mana and Health regeneration for 15 sec (was 100%). Used at a Ley Line it grants Attuned for 1 hour, which raises it back to 100%.

abilities.name: Skysight
abilities.text: +15% movement speed for 15 sec (was 10%). Used at an elemental convergence it grants Charged for 1 hour: +30%.

abilities.name: Command
abilities.text: Back: Warlock and Hunter pets deal 5% more damage. Savage (+1% crit) is removed.

abilities.name: Touch of the Grave
abilities.text: Internal cooldown 15 sec (was 25). Triggers as often as intended, and the beam visual is gone.

abilities.name: Cannibalize
abilities.text: Usable again while immune to Physical damage.

abilities.name: Plainsrunning
abilities.text: +2% movement speed per stack, up to 60% (was 1% and 30%). No longer affects mounted speed.

abilities.name: Endurance
abilities.text: Only +5% Health. The hit and critical damage bonuses are gone.

classes.name: Druid
classes.lede: Cat damage up about 25%, Bear threat more than doubled, and Feral gets separate Bear and Cat 31-point talents.

spells.name: Bear and Dire Bear Form
spells.text: Threat bonus 115% (was 50%), to make up for Blessing of Salvation being removed.

spells.name: Shred, Claw and Ravage
spells.text: Weapon damage: Shred 200% (was 155%), Claw 140% (was 110%), Ravage 435% (was 350%).

spells.name: Rip, Rake, Ferocious Bite, Pounce
spells.text: Base damage and Attack Power scaling up about 25%. Ferocious Bite gets a new Rank 1 at level 24.

spells.name: Poised
spells.text: Passive at level 32. At full Energy out of combat, your next Energy ability costs 10 less.

spells.name: Starfire
spells.text: Base damage up about 40%.

spells.name: Genesis and Moonkin Form
spells.text: Genesis 2/4/6/8/10% periodic damage and healing (was 1-5%). Moonkin crit covers all critical strikes again and is exclusive with Leader of the Pack.

spells.name: Feral 31-point talents
spells.text: Berserk removed. Primal Bite (Bear) and Shifting Power (Cat, needs the new Predatory Discipline) are both row 7 talents. Lacerate is now a row 4 talent.

spells.name: Rend and Tear
spells.text: Damage bonus 3/6/9/12/15% (was 2-10%).

spells.name: Bloom
spells.text: Replaces Gift of the Earthmother. An expiring Rejuvenation or Regrowth heals for 100% of your Spirit (50% if dispelled).

spells.name: Wild Growth and Swiftmend
spells.text: Wild Growth has a 3 sec base cast. Swiftmend needs your own Rejuvenation or Regrowth on the target. Naturalist now 2-10% damage.

classes.name: Hunter
classes.lede: Aimed Shot more than doubles, every shot scales harder, and traps share one cooldown.

spells.name: Aimed Shot
spells.text: Bonus damage up about 110% on every rank.

spells.name: Arcane Shot
spells.text: Base damage up about 30%. Attack Power coefficient 0.15 (was 0.1).

spells.name: Serpent Sting
spells.text: 5% Attack Power per tick (was 3%). Base damage up about 20%.

spells.name: Aspect of the Hawk
spells.text: Ranged Attack Power 20, 35, 50, 70, 90, 110 for ranks 1 to 6.

spells.name: Traps
spells.text: All traps share one 30 sec cooldown (Fire and Frost traps were separate).

spells.name: Hunter's Mark
spells.text: Different ranks no longer stack. Rank 4 no longer gives less than Rank 3.

spells.name: Trueshot Aura
spells.text: Ranged Attack Power 20, 35, 50, 75, 100 for ranks 1 to 5.

spells.name: Barrage and Sniper Shot
spells.text: Barrage 5/10/15% (was 3/7/10%). Sniper Shot bonus damage doubled.

classes.name: Mage
classes.lede: Frost Blast is gone, Ice Barrier becomes a damage cooldown, and Arcane Blast is cheaper to stack.

spells.name: Frost Blast
spells.text: Removed.

spells.name: Arcane Blast
spells.text: Mana cost +100% per stack (was 175%). 12% of Intellect as spell damage per stack (was 15%). Lasts 18 sec.

spells.name: Missile Barrage
spells.text: Consumed at the start of the channel. Moves to row 2, and Clearcasting is kept while it is active.

spells.name: Arcane Resilience
spells.text: Row 1, up to 3 points for armor equal to 75% of Intellect. Arcane Focus is removed and folded into Precision.

spells.name: Incineration
spells.text: Up to 5 points for 10% crit (was 3 points for 6%).

spells.name: Critical Mass
spells.text: Back to 3 points for 6% crit (was 5 points for 10%).

spells.name: Accelerant
spells.text: Improved Fireball is renamed and also cuts Arcane Wrath's cast by up to 0.5 sec. Ignite now applies to all Flamestrike damage.

spells.name: Ice Barrier
spells.text: +15% Frost damage for 1 minute, plus 5% while the barrier holds. Piercing Ice is removed.

spells.name: Ice Lance
spells.text: 8 sec cooldown shared with Fire Blast. Bonus damage against frozen targets back to 300%.

spells.name: Precision and Winter's Chill
spells.text: Precision is 3 points for 2/4/6% spell hit. Winter's Chill adds 20% Cone of Cold damage per stack.

classes.name: Paladin
classes.lede: Salvation is gone, Righteous Fury comes at level 10, and all three trees are rebuilt with new talents.

spells.name: Salvation
spells.text: Salvation, Mass Salvation, Revoke and Blessing of Light are removed.

spells.name: Righteous Fury
spells.text: Trained at level 10 (was 16). +33% to all threat, plus 90% more threat from Holy damage.

spells.name: Oath of Light
spells.text: Row 4 talent. Swear an Oath on one ally for 5 min to raise your Holy Light, Flash of Light and Holy Shock healing on them.

spells.name: Holy Power and Boundless Light
spells.text: Holy Power raises the critical healing bonus 10-50%. New Boundless Light: +15/30% Holy Shock crit on allies without your Oath.

spells.name: Shieldsworn
spells.text: Row 7 talent. Holy Strike strikes with your shield, triggers your block talents, lets you block spells for 6 sec, and has a 4 sec shorter cooldown.

spells.name: Sacred Duty and Stoicism
spells.text: Sacred Duty drops its Stamina bonus and shortens Forbearance by 5/10 sec. New Stoicism: stuns and charms 10/20% shorter.

spells.name: Unsealed Wrath
spells.text: The new 31-point talent, requires Repentance. Melee attacks store up to 3 copies of your Seal; switching Seals fires each stored copy.

spells.name: Champion of the Light
spells.text: Spell damage 12-60% of Intellect, and up to 1 sec off Hammer of Wrath's cast.

spells.name: Conviction and Two-Handed Specialization
spells.text: Conviction gives 2/4/6% crit to all spells and attacks. Two-Handed Specialization covers Holy damage and lowers threat.

classes.name: Priest
classes.lede: Shadow Word: Death bites back harder, and Binding Heal becomes Holy Binding.

spells.name: Shadow Word: Death
spells.text: Deals 30% of your maximum Health to you if it fails to kill (was 10%). No backlash on a miss.

spells.name: Power Word: Shield
spells.text: Can be replaced by a shield of equal or higher rank.

spells.name: Holy Binding
spells.text: Replaces Binding Heal. Flash Heal on another target also heals you for 50%, with no threat.

spells.name: Vampiric Embrace
spells.text: Its healing can no longer crit.

spells.name: Shadowform
spells.text: Cure Disease and Abolish Disease no longer drop you out of it. Devouring Contagion no longer spreads from critters.

classes.name: Rogue
classes.lede: The biggest rework: a new Shank ability, Poised, Death Mark, and new talents in all three trees.

spells.name: Shank
spells.text: Level 24. 5 Energy, 10 sec cooldown. Off-hand strike for 50% weapon damage that cannot miss and generates 15 Energy (25 at rank 2, level 44).

spells.name: Poised
spells.text: Passive at level 18. At full Energy out of combat, your next Energy ability costs 10 less.

spells.name: Deadly and Instant Poison
spells.text: Attack Power coefficients doubled (0.009 and 0.01).

spells.name: Mutilate
spells.text: Moves to row 7. 90% weapon damage plus a larger bonus (was 75%).

spells.name: Blood Splatter and Venom
spells.text: Blood Splatter: Rupture +6 sec, Garrote +9 sec. Venom: Shank raises poison damage 30% and poison chance 20% for 6 sec. Murder removed.

spells.name: Relentless Strikes and Seal Fate
spells.text: Relentless Strikes is 5 points, 4-20% per Combo Point to restore 25 Energy. Seal Fate is 3 points, 33/66/100%.

spells.name: Flash of Steel and Composure
spells.text: Flash of Steel: Shank generates up to 15 more Energy and has up to 2 sec less cooldown. Composure: Poised saves up to 10 more Energy.

spells.name: Coup de Grace
spells.text: Improved Eviscerate renamed. Raises Eviscerate and Death Mark damage by 7/13/20%. Dual Wield Specialization is 2 points for 25/50% off-hand damage.

spells.name: Death Mark
spells.text: Row 7 finisher, 25 Energy, 10 sec cooldown. Stores part of your damage per Combo Point (Garrote and Rupture at twice the rate) and deals it after 6 sec.

spells.name: Boot Knife and Quick Getaway
spells.text: Boot Knife: Shank up to 100% chance to add 2 Combo Points. Quick Getaway: one extra Sap target and a speed burst after Sap. Quietus, Cutthroat and Thousand Cuts removed.

classes.name: Shaman
classes.lede: Lava Burst is removed, Lightning Bolt and shocks hit much harder, and Stormstrike comes faster.

spells.name: Lightning Bolt
spells.text: Base damage raised on all ranks, max rank +80%. About 78% of Classic Era damage at a shorter cast.

spells.name: Chain Lightning
spells.text: 2.5 sec cast. About 145% of Lightning Bolt damage on the main target for about 225% of its Mana.

spells.name: Shocks
spells.text: Base damage back to Classic Era values.

spells.name: Totemic Call
spells.text: Totemic Projection renamed. Pulls your totems to you, 30 sec cooldown.

spells.name: Lava Burst
spells.text: Removed. Call of Thunder takes its place: +5% crit on Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning.

spells.name: Lightning Overload and Lightning Mastery
spells.text: Overload 10/20/30% chance (was 3/7/10%). Elemental Mastery is renamed Lightning Mastery.

spells.name: Stormstrike
spells.text: 150% normalized weapon damage (was 100%), 6 sec cooldown (was 8). Maelstrom Weapon triggers twice as often.

spells.name: Flurry and Mental Dexterity
spells.text: Flurry 6-30% attack speed (was 5-25%). Mental Dexterity gives 50/100/150% of Intellect as Attack Power.

spells.name: Riptide
spells.text: Heal over time only, no initial heal. About 40% cheaper, 12 sec cooldown (was 6).

classes.name: Warlock
classes.lede: Wrack more than doubles at 60, pets lose Health, and Shadow and Flame doubles.

spells.name: Pet Health
spells.text: Pets gain 2 Health per point of your Stamina (was 7.5).

spells.name: Drain Soul
spells.text: Much lower chance to grant a Soul Shard from damage that does not kill.

spells.name: Spellstones and Bane of Agony
spells.text: Spellstones raise only Shadow damage. Bane of Agony updates its damage as it should.

spells.name: Wrack
spells.text: Spell damage coefficient doubled. Base damage per second at level 60 goes from 36 to 86.

spells.name: Amplify Curse and Improved Drains
spells.text: Amplify Curse affects Curse of Exhaustion and Bane of Agony. Improved Drains boosts Drain Mana, not Wrack.

spells.name: Shadow and Flame
spells.text: Fire or Shadow damage +4/8/12/16/20% (was 2-10%).

classes.name: Warrior
classes.lede: Tank threat jumps, Slam comes faster, and Fury gets Reckless Swings and Improved Whirlwind.

spells.name: Defensive Stance
spells.text: Threat bonus 80% (was 30%).

spells.name: Slam
spells.text: Cooldown 15 sec (was 18).

spells.name: Two-Handed Specialization
spells.text: 2/4/6% damage with a two-handed weapon (was 1/2/3%).

spells.name: Tactical Mastery and Bloodthrill
spells.text: Improved Tactical Mastery is 3 points for 5/10/15 Rage kept. Bloodthrill is 2 points, 10/20% Overpower chance.

spells.name: Reckless Swings
spells.text: Row 4, 15 sec cooldown, costs 25% of base Health. Your next 4 melee attacks generate 5 extra Rage.

spells.name: Improved Whirlwind
spells.text: Row 6. Whirlwind cooldown 1/2 sec shorter, 15/30% more damage to the closest enemy.

spells.name: Flurry
spells.text: 3 points for 10/20/30% attack speed for 3 swings. No longer needs Death Wish; Bloodthirst does.

quests.text: Respawn rates adjusted for launch crowds: fastest in starting zones, slower as you level. Lower zones go back to normal once the launch surge settles.
Dalaran Summoners no longer summon without end.
Talk to Rethgar Deathgate to start "Counterattack!". Alliance Outrunners spawn in random places.
Dungeon quests all need level 15 (was a mix of 15 and 16).
Fewer spiders in The Cleft for "Twisted Hatred".
Carnage no longer resets near the end of "Carnage". Alba Fairmoon stays for "Destruction in Deadmines".

gear.name: Bags
gear.text: No longer equip themselves into empty bag slots. Equip them by hand.

gear.name: Replica Ironforge Air Rifle (Legacy)
gear.text: Usable on allies who also have one equipped.

gear.name: Darkspear Islands
gear.text: Dropping the flag no longer gives you the Recently Dropped Flag debuff.

interface.name: Gamepad support
interface.text: Complete: movement, spells, interaction and all core interface work on a controller. Set it up in Edit Mode and Options.

interface.name: Ground-targeted items
interface.text: AoE items on the gamepad action bar can be placed. Press the button again to confirm.

interface.name: Gamepad bags
interface.text: New bag UI with free space and ammo counters, better Keyring navigation and search.

interface.name: Focus target and corpses
interface.text: LB + RB + Face Down targets your focus. Friendly corpses and critters can be targeted.

interface.name: Flight paths
interface.text: Back/Cancel ends a flight early at the next flight point.

interface.name: Popups
interface.text: Popups you did not open no longer steal gamepad focus.
